what: Chapter 13 of the introduction, "Plans sealed before the market closes", as a 5 s loop for the chapter panes: the beat at the site's rest, drawn without its caption, scope line or plates, the camera drifting round its rest pose and back. Positions are schematic, as in the story.
name: Plans sealed before the market closes
